help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Learn how to get the most out of Ascend.

whatIs.title: What is Ascend?
whatIs.body: Ascend is a League of Legends self-coaching desktop app. It helps you improve through a structured workflow: assessments, focused sessions, game reviews, detailed stats, and progression tracking over time — all local-first, with no cloud dependency.
whatIs.why: No more scattered tools: one place to set your focus areas, review your games, and measure your progress.

workflow.title: How does it work?
workflow.body: The Ascend improvement cycle has 5 steps:
steps: Periodic Fundamental Assessment — Rate your skills across the game's core fundamentals when you feel you've reached a milestone, or periodically.
Session — Pick one or more objectives and start playing.
Recording — Auto-record your games or link external VODs for later review.
Review — After each game, score your KPIs, add timestamped notes, and rate your objectives.
Stats — Check detailed game stats and progression trends at the end of each session.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.body: An overview of your progress: level, streak, suggested next session, recent results, and quick trends.
dashboard.why: See everything that matters at a glance before you queue up.

session.title: Session
session.body: Create a practice session by selecting one or more objectives (fundamentals). Ascend auto-detects when your games end and prompts you to review them.
session.why: Stay focused on specific goals instead of playing on autopilot.

record.title: Recording
record.body: Auto-record your games with the built-in capture (ffmpeg). You can also manually link video files or YouTube/Insight Capture links. Recordings are tied to games for easy review access.
record.why: Having the VOD at hand during review dramatically improves the quality of your analysis.

review.title: Review
review.body: After each game, rate your KPIs on the selected objectives, add timestamped notes on the timeline, and log your impressions. You can also access external reviews shared by other players.
review.why: Structured review turns a simple 'GG / FF' into concrete learning.

history.title: History
history.body: Browse all your past games with filters by account, role, and champion. Jump to the review or detailed stats for any game.
history.why: Spot recurring patterns by browsing your complete history.

stats.title: Detailed Stats
stats.body: Explore detailed stats for each game: CS, vision, damage, gold, timeline, and rank average comparison.
stats.why: Hard numbers to understand what worked and what didn't in every game.

analytics.title: Analytics / Progression
analytics.body: Visualize your skill progression over time with trend charts. Compare fundamental assessments, session averages, and track your trends by objective.
analytics.why: Measure real progress instead of relying on gut feeling.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Manage your Riot accounts, configure auto-recording (folder, audio sources, mic), Discord webhooks, YouTube links, and experimental options.
settings.why: Tailor Ascend to your setup for a smooth workflow.

tips.title: Tips & Shortcuts
items: Enable auto-recording in settings so you never forget to capture a game.
Use timestamped notes during review to mark key moments in the game using the 'mark' button to gain more time
Compare fundamental assessments to see your progress between evaluations.
Filter by account and role in history to analyze a specific champion pool.
Share your reviews via Discord webhook to get feedback from your community.

reason.absentNoWard: No ward to set it up
reason.notContestable: Not contestable: right call to give it
reason.xpLost: XP lost away from the wave
reason.cycleBreak: Jungle cycle mistake: I broke my pathing for an isolated camp (or overchased) instead of resetting my top-to-bot cycle
reason.invadeWorth: Profitable invade: I gained more than I lost
reason.tempoGreed: Tempo delay: I hit one tower or wave too many before recalling instead of being on the objective (or committing to a real cross-map)
reason.setupFail: Bad objective setup: went straight into the river without going through mid (or forced a losing 3v3 instead of taking mid with 3)
reason.passiveClear: Missed opportunity: I kept a passive full clear while my mid/bot lanes had full priority to invade
reason.noInvadeWindow: No real window (enemy summoners up, shaky priority): clearing was right
reason.assignment131: 1-3-1 assignment mistake: wrong split between who takes the mid wave and who covers in the jungle
reason.baronSiege: Baron siege mistake: I forced a tower without info on the other lane (or recalled / answered a threatless side laner for nothing)
reason.baronTrade: Accepted trade under Baron: we took the payoff on the other lane
reason.tempoLineDesync: Tempo line break: I recalled 20 s too late (or moved up alone while my team was leaving base)
reason.frontAlone: Alone on front tempo: I moved up before my team left base
reason.tempoTradeOk: Accepted trade: the payoff was worth the lost fight
reason.gankTimer: Jungle tracking ignored: died on a predictable clear timing (3-camp transition or end of the first clear) with no deep ward or hover away
reason.singleThreat: Key threat ignored: I had the shutdown/lead and gave the angle to the one engage spell that could kill me
reason.waveRotation: Wave management mistake: I broke the slow → fast rule or my rotation ran past the bounce timer (waves lost under tower)
reason.badFightChoice: Bad fight choice: I joined a fight lost in advance (down in numbers or spikes) instead of keeping my wave
reason.rotationWorth: Worthwhile rotation: the fight was worth the lost waves
reason.tradingLaws: Trading mistake: I wasted my key spell outside a last-hit window (or traded an enemy who was about to back)
reason.waveSide: Wrong side of the wave: I traded through enemy minions (or stayed on the same side as a stronger opponent)
reason.doubleSpend: Tempo spent twice: I tried to chain two actions (objective + wave or camp) without resetting and got punished on their respawn
reason.tempoWindowUnused: Tempo window wasted: the enemy jungler showed on the other side and I punished nothing (passive farming of my camps)
reason.noTempoWindow: No real window: my lanes had no priority to punish
reason.chokePoint: Choke point mistake: I stayed stuck in the objective pit instead of locking the choke point upstream
reason.pitRole: My job: I had to tank or burst the objective
reason.ecoTempo: Real economic tempo deficit: I fought a level behind, with too little HP/mana, or kept my Barrier/Heal too late
reason.summonerLate: Defensive summoner used too late (or not at all)
reason.forcedFight: Forced fight despite the deficit (objective or base defense)
reason.asymmetryMidPrio: Asymmetry / mid priority mistake: I pushed a side lane without mid priority (or we spread out in a 1-3-1 while behind)
reason.archetypeTrough: Archetype misread: I forced during my champion's power trough
reason.archetype3v3: Archetype misread: I played the 1v1 ignoring that our 3v3 was losing
reason.roamCheck: Losing roam: I forced a roam without checking it would pay off (plates and waves lost for an unguaranteed play)
reason.lowEnergy: Overload / fatigue: I tried a complex mechanical play (or ignored a suspicious enemy move) when I should simply have neutralised the wave
reason.lateReset: Late reset: I sat on my gold instead of recalling with my team
reason.assumed: My call: this was not a mistake
reason.diveOneForOne: Rushed dive: I threw every spell under their tower and ended 1-for-1 instead of waiting for their defensive spell (or I forced it while already ahead)
reason.diveTrade: Accepted 1-for-1: the kill was worth my death (plate, wave or shutdown)
reason.levelSpike: Caught by a level-up: I took the trade while they were about to reach level 2 (7th minion) or level 3 (2nd minion of the cannon wave) mid-fight
reason.backTimer: Missed back timer: low on HP with gold, I moved into the river or jungle instead of recalling
reason.laneVolatility: Volatility misjudged: I took long trades that left me at half HP against a strong all-in or an aggressive early jungler
reason.rangeMelee: Ranged against melee mistake: as the ranged champion I lost too much HP (minion aggro); as the melee I let them chip me without making the lane volatile or crashing
reason.cheaterRecall: Bad cheater recall: I backed at high HP, without TP and without chunking the opponent, and they kept the big wave
reason.supportEarly: Support level 1-2 fundamentals: wrong level-1 bush ward, support item charges wasted on the 1st wave, or the 20 s without the enemy Aftershock left unpunished
reason.trinketSaved: Trinket saved on purpose for the 2:30 gank: my call
reason.pressureDesync: Pressure out of sync: I pushed while my team was resetting or my jungler was farming the other side
reason.tradeRecall: Pressure out of sync: a mutual trade at half HP forced me to back right before the objective skirmish
reason.forcedRecall: Forced back: with no HP or mana left, staying meant dying
reason.adcReopen: Re-open / useless-zone mistake: I went to push a side lane alone straight out of base (or stood idle in the middle of mid after my wave)
reason.baronRecall: Jungle decision mistake: I recalled (or farmed my jungle) during Baron while fed, and my team got caught 4v5
reason.inhibDive: Jungle decision mistake: a forced dive under their towers although the inhibitor was given for free
reason.endPush: Going for the end: the Nexus was within reach
reason.lateFirstRecall: Broken clear structure: I did not recall at T-25 s of my 1st camp's respawn and delayed my 2nd cycle
reason.stayedForPlay: I stayed for a planned play (Scuttle Crab, gank or covering a lane)
reason.campsUpGank: An uncertain gank with my camps up: under 90 % odds, and the enemy jungler got 2 camps ahead meanwhile
reason.gankExecution: Gank execution: I wasted my dash on the way in instead of cutting the path on foot
reason.gankTrade: The gank burned an enemy Flash or summoner: an accepted trade
reason.weakSideFirst: Weak side forgotten: I went to my strong side without clearing my weak-side camps, and they were stolen
reason.yellowTrinket: No info on the enemy jungler: yellow trinket not used on their camps (or Sweeper taken too early)
reason.invadeGreed: Second-camp greed on an invade: after stealing the first camp I forced the next one without the mid wave pushed (or my dash kept to escape)
reason.invadeOrder: Invade order reversed: I took my camps or the Scuttle Crab before going in (front to back instead of red → yellow → green)
reason.dragonScenarios: Suicidal Dragon: I tanked it with the enemies next to it, outside the only 2 scenarios (proven lead or cleared vision)
reason.compensation: Compensation death: an ally had just fallen and I forced while outnumbered instead of trading on the other side or minimizing on my camps
reason.earlyBoots: Boots too early: bought at 0 kills before my 1st item, they delayed my Pickaxe or Phage for the 5:30-7:00 duel
reason.bootsNeeded: Boots needed: gank distance, kiting or the matchup called for them
reason.leaveT1: T1 destroyed instead of leaving it at 1 HP: it would have eaten the allied wave and forced the bounce
reason.t1Worth: Worth the tower: it opened an objective or the map
reason.heraldUnused: Wasted Herald: died in a skirmish with the Eye of the Herald in my pocket, unused to engage or escape
reason.neverFlee: Fled the invade: I ran at very low HP leaving my camps instead of dumping my damage for my ally's kill

reason.burstSmite: Smite out of sync: I cast Smite before my burst spell, leaving a window to steal
